Treasure

Treasure is generated by lettered types that specify coins, gems, jewelry and magical items. Gold, electrum, silver, copper and platinum have different values; gems and jewelry are valued individually and weigh less than coins.

Magical items include potions, scrolls, rings, wands, staves, swords, armor and miscellaneous items. Missile talents such as speaking, stunning, teleporting, transporting and wounding are separate from ordinary item powers. Creating an item costs gold and spell levels and requires a roll for success.
